headline: Barry Callebaut Flavourcode push; Lesaffre vs CVC for Corbion; Roquette, Palsgaard launches
summary: Barry Callebaut's Flavourcode platform for fermentation-controlled cocoa flavour dominated the week, a direct challenge to Belcolade's own cocoa-fermentation work that calls for a gap assessment.

Cocoa alternatives keep advancing, with Planet A Foods launching a fibre-rich cocoa powder replacer and Win-Win targeting mass-market chocolate, while easing cocoa prices and Lindt price cuts shift the business case for cocoa saving.

Competitors launched new bakery and patisserie functionality, Roquette with a gluten-free hydrocolloid and Palsgaard with a powder cake emulsifier, and CVC and Lesaffre are bidding for Corbion, which could reshape the bakery-ingredient landscape.

In US regulation, FDA cleared salt substitutes in standardized breads, while the stalled federal ultra-processed food definition and spreading state MAHA rules keep clean-label reformulation pressure on bakery customers.
Yeast proteins from Spacemilk and Revyve and cheaper fermented brazzein point to new protein-enrichment and sugar-reduction options worth evaluating for bakery and fillings.

items.title: Barry Callebaut launches innovative chocolate flavour platform
items.summary: Barry Callebaut launched a chocolate flavour platform built on controlled cocoa fermentation.
items.why: A direct competitor move in controlled cocoa fermentation, the area Belcolade is working on; assess the gap and accelerate Belcolade's own fermentation-flavour offer.

items.title: Barry Callebaut’s Flavourcode aims to raise the cocoa bar to new heights
items.summary: Barry Callebaut launched Flavourcode, a fermentation-led platform to control and scale cocoa flavour profiles.
items.why: A direct competitor move in controlled cocoa fermentation, the area Belcolade is working on; assess the gap and accelerate Belcolade's own fermentation-flavour offer.

items.title: Chocolate demand lags cocoa grinding rebound as Lindt cuts prices
items.summary: Cocoa grinding has rebounded but chocolate demand lags, and Lindt is cutting prices as cocoa costs ease.
items.why: Easing cocoa prices and Lindt's price cuts signal pressure on chocolate pricing; review Belcolade pricing and the business case for cocoa-saving products as costs fall.

items.title: Temperature selection drives microbial adaptation and succession during repeated back-slopping of spontaneous sourdough and modulates bread quality
items.summary: A study shows that the temperature used in repeated back-slopping of spontaneous sourdough selects different microbes and changes bread quality.
items.why: Directly relevant to Sapore sourdough: temperature as a lever to steer sourdough microbiota and bread flavour.

items.title: Cracking the code on cocoa flavour
items.summary: A trade article on new approaches to controlling cocoa flavour, likely covering fermentation-led platforms.
items.why: Fits the controlled cocoa-fermentation trend Belcolade is investing in; check which competitors and methods are featured.

items.title: Opinion | Avoid whole-wheat bread? RFK Jr.’s warning would be harmful — and costly.
items.summary: A Washington Post opinion piece argues that a warning from HHS Secretary RFK Jr. against whole-wheat bread would be harmful and costly.
items.why: Federal messaging against whole-wheat bread could hit demand for wholegrain and fibre-enriched bread in the US; watch for formal guidance and prepare customer talking points on wholegrain health evidence.

items.title: Baker’s yeast muscles into high-protein snacks
items.summary: Start-up Spacemilk is positioning baker's yeast protein as a whey alternative for high-protein bakery and snacks as whey prices rise.
items.why: A yeast-derived protein for high-protein bakery is a partnership or ingredient option for Puratos protein-enrichment solutions.

items.title: Mondelez sues vegan chocolate startup in Toblerone copycat dispute
items.summary: Mondelez is suing a vegan chocolate start-up over a bar it says copies Toblerone.
items.why: Shows big brands defending shapes and trade dress against plant-based chocolate entrants; a caution for customers launching look-alike products with Belcolade.

items.title: KSU Grain and Food Science Department, PMAN Sign Five-Year Baking Research Agreement - News and Statistics
items.summary: Kansas State University's Grain and Food Science department signed a five-year baking research agreement with PMAN.
items.why: A new industry-academic baking research partnership in the US to watch for competitive or collaboration opportunities.

items.title: CVC takes on French yeast giant Lesaffre in battle for Dutch group Corbion
items.summary: Private equity firm CVC is competing with yeast maker Lesaffre to acquire Dutch ingredient group Corbion.
items.why: Lesaffre buying Corbion would combine a major yeast and bakery-ingredient competitor with Corbion's preservation and emulsifier portfolio; monitor the outcome for competitive impact on Puratos.

items.title: Scaling up sweet proteins
items.summary: Fermentation is increasing supply and lowering the cost of brazzein, a sweet protein for sugar reduction.
items.why: Cheaper fermented brazzein could become a viable sugar-reduction tool for fillings, cakes and reduced-sugar chocolate; track suppliers for trials.

items.title: Aqueous Chlorine Dioxide Tempering of Wheat Kernels: Evaluation of Enzyme Activity, Flour Functionality, and Baking Properties
items.summary: Kansas State University tested tempering wheat kernels with aqueous chlorine dioxide and measured its effect on flour enzyme activity, functionality and baking quality.
items.why: A milling-stage microbial control step that may change flour enzyme activity matters for how Puratos improvers and enzymes perform in treated flour.

items.title: Spatio-temporal coupling of satellite and reanalysis hydro-meteorological signals for cocoa market volatility
items.summary: Researchers at Illinois and Toronto linked satellite soil moisture and weather signals over West African cocoa areas to cocoa futures price shifts.
items.why: Earth-observation signals that anticipate cocoa price shocks could help Belcolade sourcing and hedging decisions.

items.title: Samyang Corporation to Participate in SupplySide Global 2026, Strengthening Sugar Reduction Solutions and Dietary Fiber Portfolio
items.summary: Samyang Corporation will showcase sugar-reduction solutions, such as allulose, and dietary fibre at SupplySide Global 2026.
items.why: A sugar-reduction and fibre supplier to benchmark or source from for reduced-sugar cakes, fillings and sweet goods.

items.title: An Interpretable Decision-Support Architecture for Batch Production with POS-Only Operational Data: A Point-in-Time Evaluation
items.summary: Salisbury University evaluated a simple, interpretable forecasting tool that recommends daily bread batch counts for small bakeries from POS data alone.
items.why: A low-data production-planning tool for small bakeries fits Puratos digital services for artisan and in-store customers.

items.title: Your Halloween Candy Isn't Secretly Lab Grown. But Chocolate Is Changing.
items.summary: A consumer article explains that Halloween candy is not lab-grown but that chocolate is changing with cocoa alternatives and cell-based cocoa.
items.why: Shows cocoa alternatives reaching mainstream consumer media in the US; relevant to Belcolade's positioning on cocoa-free products.

items.title: Revyve unveils high-PDCAAS yeast protein for nutrition
items.summary: Revyve launched a yeast protein with a high PDCAAS score for nutrition applications.
items.why: A functional yeast protein could serve egg replacement and protein enrichment in bakery and patisserie; a partnership target.

items.title: Free-from sweet bakery brand Lazy Day Foods acquired by Baker & Baker
items.summary: Baker & Baker acquired free-from sweet bakery brand Lazy Day Foods.
items.why: Consolidation in free-from sweet bakery; Baker & Baker is a potential customer for Puratos gluten-free and allergen-free solutions.

items.title: Integrating compost and biochar as climate-smart soil amendments to enhance cocoa yield, profitability, and sustainability in Ghana
items.summary: Field trials in Ghana found that compost and biochar combined with half-rate fertiliser raised cocoa bean yields by 74-93% and improved soil.
items.why: Practical yield gains for smallholder cocoa are relevant to Belcolade's Cacao-Trace sustainability and sourcing programmes.

items.title: FMI: Shoppers go for in-store bakery over aisles
items.summary: An FMI study finds shoppers rate in-store fresh bakery above centre-store packaged bakery on 10 of 13 attributes.
items.why: Supports Puratos's in-store bakery business in the US; useful for selling fresh-bakery solutions to retailers.

items.title: MAHA Goes to the States: The Emerging Patchwork of Food Regulation
items.summary: A legal analysis describes how MAHA-style food rules are spreading through US states, creating a patchwork of ingredient and labelling requirements.
items.why: A state-by-state patchwork on dyes, additives and warnings complicates national recipes for US bakery and confectionery customers; track key states and offer compliant reformulations.
